announcing-recomp-hub.title: GTA 6 PC RECOMPILED — Dedicated Tracking Site & Community Hub
announcing-recomp-hub.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
announcing-recomp-hub.excerpt: Announcing gta6recomp.com as the centralized hub tracking GTA 6 PC recompilation projects, verified GitHub repositories, community Discord groups, and interactive tools.

anyxboxx-two-missions-victory-fork-7fps-.title: AnyXboxX Completes Two Missions, victory-fork Hits 7.6 FPS on RTX 4090 & ztrx Runs 90 Mins
anyxboxx-two-missions-victory-fork-7fps-.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
anyxboxx-two-missions-victory-fork-7fps-.excerpt: AnyXboxX completes the first two missions and hits 5.3–6.9 FPS in-world, Hyphen's victory-fork reaches 7.6 FPS on an RTX 4090 via PR, and ztrx runs the opening mission for 90+ minutes on an RTX 3050.

cgbj-in-game-private-group-victory-xcl.title: Dev Blog: CGBJ Reaches In-Game — Technical Deep-Dive into the VIctory + XCL Hybrid
cgbj-in-game-private-group-victory-xcl.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
cgbj-in-game-private-group-victory-xcl.excerpt: A technical breakdown of CGBJ's private build: how combining VIctory's runtime with XCL's shader engine enabled in-game player movement and NPC interaction.

cgbj-reaches-in-game-prologue-cutscene-n.title: CGBJ Reaches In-Game: Prologue 'Nine Months Ago' Cutscene Renders on PC
cgbj-reaches-in-game-prologue-cutscene-n.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
cgbj-reaches-in-game-prologue-cutscene-n.excerpt: Major milestone: Private group CGBJ has showcased GTA 6's first prologue cutscene ('NINE MONTHS AGO') rendering on PC with early shaders, achieving controller movement and in-game walking.

cyberleek-releases-gta6-xbox-exe.title: Cyberleek Drops GTA 6 Xbox Executable: Official Hashes, Verification Guide & Recomp Impact
cyberleek-releases-gta6-xbox-exe.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
cyberleek-releases-gta6-xbox-exe.excerpt: Cyberleek has officially released the missing launch executable for GTA 6 Xbox Build 1.0.2.1. Here are the verified SHA-256 hashes, verification commands, and what this means for Leonida and PC recompilation teams.

cyberleek-xbox-build-leak.title: Cyberleek Leaks GTA 6 Xbox Build 1.0.2.1: 209 GB Distributed and What It Means
cyberleek-xbox-build-leak.author: The team
cyberleek-xbox-build-leak.excerpt: A breakdown of the 209 GB GTA 6 Xbox build leak by Cyberleek, the missing executable ransom stunt, and how our static recompilation project is using this build.

dexnom-ray-tracing-open-world-belobug-am.title: DexNom Enables Ray-Traced Lighting & Open-World Water on PC, Belobug Renders Lit Open World (31%)
dexnom-ray-tracing-open-world-belobug-am.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
dexnom-ray-tracing-open-world-belobug-am.excerpt: DexNom/VIctory takes #1 at 31% with live ray-traced lighting and open-world water reflections on AMD, while Belobug renders the lit open world at 3–5 FPS and cuts scene GPU time from 225ms to 80ms.

hyphen-first-graphics-render-gta6-pc-rtx.title: Heavily Improved 3D Graphics Render: Hyphen Hits 24% Progress at 3 FPS on RTX 4090
hyphen-first-graphics-render-gta6-pc-rtx.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
hyphen-first-graphics-render-gta6-pc-rtx.excerpt: Historic milestone: Hyphen delivers a heavily improved 3D in-game graphics render on PC with early raytracing, prison yard footage, and Lucia shaders, holding 3 FPS on an NVIDIA RTX 4090.

leonida-notrexed-hookshot-history.title: Who Made Leonida? ItsNotRexed, the Developer Behind the Hookshot OoT Recomp
leonida-notrexed-hookshot-history.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
leonida-notrexed-hookshot-history.excerpt: The developer behind Leonida previously built Hookshot, the Ocarina of Time PC recompilation that briefly disappeared from GitHub. Here's the full history and what it means for GTA 6.

leonida-nuked-discord-takedown-notrexed-.title: Leonida Is Nuked: Discord Banned, GitHub Repo Deleted, Creator NotRexed Quits
leonida-nuked-discord-takedown-notrexed-.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
leonida-nuked-discord-takedown-notrexed-.excerpt: Within hours on Monday night, Leonida — the most starred GTA 6 recompilation project — lost its 179,000-member Discord to a copyright strike, deleted its GitHub repository, and creator NotRexed announced his exit.

new-group-cgbj-emerges-gta6-pc-scene.title: New Group "CGBJ" Emerges: Underground Collective Shakes Up the GTA 6 PC Scene
new-group-cgbj-emerges-gta6-pc-scene.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
new-group-cgbj-emerges-gta6-pc-scene.excerpt: Following the takedown of Leonida, an underground collective named CGBJ has surfaced with in-game movement, operating under a strict anti-DMCA blackout.

omonkey-gta6-pc-5fps-prison-shaders-rumb.title: omonkey Reaches In-Game at 5 FPS: Shaders Loading in Lucia's Prison, Streamed Live on Rumble
omonkey-gta6-pc-5fps-prison-shaders-rumb.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
omonkey-gta6-pc-5fps-prison-shaders-rumb.excerpt: New contender omonkey surges to #1 at 20% progress with shaders loading in Lucia's prison at ~5 FPS and slow player movement, streamed live on Rumble.

rorodev6-victory-series-s-mode-7-9fps-rx.title: rorodev6/victory Hits 7–9 FPS with Bodies on RX 6700 XT via Series S Mode (3× Speedup)
rorodev6-victory-series-s-mode-7-9fps-rx.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
rorodev6-victory-series-s-mode-7-9fps-rx.excerpt: rorodev6 rebases onto shadowdog00's Series S mode build with an upscaler stand-in, pooled GPU memory, and top-left FPS counter — hitting 7–9 FPS with character bodies on an RX 6700 XT, live on Rumble.

soldsawn-8gb-nvidia-ztrx-gone-fishing-le.title: soldsawn/victory-nvidia-8gb Hits 6 FPS on 8 GB GPUs, ztrx Reaches 'Gone Fishing' & Leonida Continued
soldsawn-8gb-nvidia-ztrx-gone-fishing-le.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
soldsawn-8gb-nvidia-ztrx-gone-fishing-le.excerpt: soldsawn tunes victory-fork for 8 GB NVIDIA GPUs at ~6 FPS, Zettrox/ztrx clears Lucia's prologue into Jason's first mission, and ubiquitarianism/leonida continues Leonida with official Discord & Telegram.

three-projects-reach-in-game-anyxboxx-cg.title: Three Projects Now Reach In-Game: AnyXboxX Joins CGBJ and VIctory in Major Breakthrough
three-projects-reach-in-game-anyxboxx-cg.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
three-projects-reach-in-game-anyxboxx-cg.excerpt: AnyXboxX has entered Stage 6 (In-Game) with a controllable character and movement tutorial on an RTX 4070 SUPER, while VIctory achieves a 6-minute in-game run on an RTX 4080 Super.

victory-amd-clean-3d-cutscenes-shader-wa.title: JoshuuDev's victory-amd Takes #1 at 28%: Clean 3D Cutscenes & Shader Warm-Up on AMD Hardware
victory-amd-clean-3d-cutscenes-shader-wa.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
victory-amd-clean-3d-cutscenes-shader-wa.excerpt: New #1 contender JoshuuDev/victory-amd reaches 28% progress with clean full-color 3D cutscenes, neon lighting, and Lucia & Jason renders using AMD fixes and pre-warmed shaders.

victory-first-pc-bootup-gta6.title: First PC Bootup: VIctory Boots Leaked GTA 6 Build to Menus & World Loading on Windows
victory-first-pc-bootup-gta6.author: GTA6 Recomp Team
victory-first-pc-bootup-gta6.excerpt: Historic milestone: VIctory by Marvisak has booted the leaked GTA 6 Xbox Series X build natively on Windows at 30 FPS, reaching menus, saves, and world loading.
